_readme: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the workshop. Edit here and every page, the poster, the QR codes, the calendar files, the JSON-LD and the social cards update on the next build. Prose in i18n.json, src/_data/pagecopy/*.json, copy.json, faq.json and schedule.json never repeats the email, date, times or Zoom numbers: it uses tokens such as {email}, {date}, {time}, {startsAlso}, {zoomId} and {passcode}, which the build fills in from here. The exceptions are description and metaDescription, which spell the time out in plain text; update them by hand if the time ever changes. Field notes are in docs/EDITING.md.
name: The Incredible Tapestry
title: The Incredible Tapestry: Weaving the Steps, Traditions & Concepts Together
tagline: Weaving the Steps, Traditions & Concepts into One Fellowship
subtitle: How the Steps, Traditions and Concepts weave this incredible tapestry
description: A free, 1-day online A.A. workshop on Saturday, December 12, 2026, 11 AM – 7 PM ET (8 AM PT · 9 AM MT · 10 AM CT): a series of presentations on how the Steps, Traditions and Concepts weave this incredible tapestry, with plenty of time for sharing and asking questions. On Zoom, with Spanish and ASL interpretation. No pre-registration is required.

event.name: The Incredible Tapestry Workshop
event.cost: Free. There will be some expenses for the Spanish and ASL interpretation, and contributions are welcome to help cover them.
event.audience: Open to all A.A. members, anyone who thinks they might have a problem with alcohol, and trusted servants at every level. Newcomers warmly welcome.

interpretation.label: Spanish interpretation
interpretation.note: Choose the Spanish channel from the Interpretation (globe) button in Zoom. On a phone or tablet, it is under More, then Language Interpretation.
interpretation.noteEs: En Zoom, el canal en español se elige con el botón Interpretación (Interpretation, el globo terráqueo). En el teléfono o la tableta, está en Más (More) y luego en Interpretación de idiomas (Language Interpretation).

interpretation.label: ASL interpretation
interpretation.labelEs: Interpretación en ASL (lengua de señas americana)
interpretation.note: Choose ASL from the Interpretation (globe) button to open Zoom's sign language view if it is offered, or pin the interpreter's video.
interpretation.noteEs: Desde el botón Interpretación (Interpretation, el globo terráqueo) se puede elegir ASL para abrir la vista de lengua de señas de Zoom, si está disponible, o bien fijar (Pin) el video del intérprete.

contact._readme: email is the questions address printed on the official flyer. Every page PRINTS it once, in the questions band at the top of the footer (and the printable poster prints it); everywhere else (FAQ answers, the contributions note, the accessibility note) it is a link labelled 'Email the planning committee' / 'Escribir al comité organizador' (i18n contact.linkText; in Markdown prose [email the planning committee](mailto:{email})); never write a bare {email} in prose, which would print it a second time. The calendar entry (DESCRIPTION) and the JSON-LD carry it too. Leave it empty only to hide all of them. icsOrganizer: true would also write it as the .ics ORGANIZER; it is off because Outlook then treats the entry as a meeting request. formUrl: optional link to a contact form (leave empty).
contact.committee: The Incredible Tapestry Workshop Planning Committee

flyer._readme: The committee's official flyer (English; image-only PDF), published from brand/flyer/. To replace it, drop new files there with the same names and update width/height (of the -1000 image), pdfSize/jpgSize (the real file sizes, shown next to the download buttons) and the three zoom* fields. zoomMeetingId, zoomPasscode and zoomJoinUrl are the Zoom details the flyer image prints: when any of them differs from event.zoom, pages warn above the flyer that its Zoom details are out of date.
